items.note: I made the stop-gap money-safe; the structural fix still needs a schema change I am not allowed to make (see needsOtherFiles). POST /tip-pools/:id/post now refuses with 409 KIOSK_STAFF_NOT_IN_POOL when someone with no login (an HrEmployee only) worked the window at the brand. Before this, the post went through and split the whole pot among the login holders. The error names each person and their hours. There are two ways to clear it. (a) Give the person a login linked to their HR record, then delete the draft and compute it again; they then join the pool on their real hours. (b) The approver passes leaveOutKioskStaff {employeeIds, reason (at least 5 characters)} and names every kiosk-only person; their names, hours and the reason go into the tippool.post audit metadata. reviewDraft now returns a separate `kioskStaff` list. The REASON_TEXT and the UI copy no longer say 'pay outside the pool'. The tip-pools page lists kiosk staff with a checkbox and a reason field. As a side fix, the tippool.post and tippool.distribute audit rows (and the outlier exception) now carry the pool's own company instead of the operator's active company. New tests in backend/tests/auditPeopleTips.test.ts (HR-R7 block, 3 tests, two companies): a blind post gets 409; naming someone else's employee (company B's dishwasher) gets 409; an empty reason gets 400; company B's kiosk staff never appear in company A's pool; once the helper has a login, a recomputed pool splits PKR 600 as 150/450 for 2h vs 6h; a named leave-out posts and is audited under company A; company B gets 404 trying to post A's pool.

I did the part that is in my files: the tip-pools page now hides '+ New pool' when /tip-pools returns 403, and it already showed 'Tip pools need the Payroll module…'. I did not change any role defaults. Whether floor or F&B managers should draft pools is the owner's call; today the CEO can grant 'payroll' per role or per person in Module Access. The dead link itself is in frontend/admin/src/app/accounting/page.tsx, which is outside my files; the change is described in needsOtherFiles. The existing auditPeopleAccess.test.ts already checks the 403s for manager roles and that a manager granted 'payroll' gets in.

The interrupted earlier attempt had already added it; I checked it. MODULE_PAGES.payroll now has { label: 'Payroll register', href: '/hr/payroll' } next to Tip pools. The sidebar (AppShell itemsForModules) and pagesForModules skip an href they have already shown, so HR, which holds both staff_hr and payroll, sees the link once. moduleForPath has no callers. Finance can read GET /hr/payroll/runs and runs/:id (PAYROLL_READERS), and the /hr/payroll gate accepts staff_hr or payroll.

needsOtherFiles:
1) HR-R7, the structural fix (schema.prisma plus a migration; I may edit neither):
- In TipPoolMember, make `userId String?` and add `employeeId String?` with `employee HrEmployee? @relation(fields:[employeeId], references:[id])` and `@@index([employeeId])`.
- Replace `@@unique([poolId, userId])` with two partial unique indexes in SQL: (poolId, userId) WHERE userId IS NOT NULL, and (poolId, employeeId) WHERE employeeId IS NOT NULL. Add a CHECK that userId or employeeId is not null.
- Consider adding tenantId to tip_pools: today the model carries no tenantId and is scoped only through conceptId, which breaks the CLAUDE.md rule for new tables.
- Once that lands, tipPools/routes.ts hoursAtBrand/computePool should build members from HrEmployee: kiosk-only staff become members with employeeId, and their weight comes from their designation (barista, or a new designation-to-weight map). The KIOSK_STAFF_NOT_IN_POOL block can then go.

2) HR-R8: in frontend/admin/src/app/accounting/page.tsx (around line 144), filter the card grid by the signed-in user's modules from GET /permissions/me. Show Tip pools only with 'payroll', Gift cards only with 'gift_cards', Payroll only with 'staff_hr' or 'payroll', and Audit log per its gate. Today fnb_manager, who holds 'accounting', sees cards whose APIs return 403.
prodNotes:
1) Tip pools: a draft whose window a kiosk-only (no-login) person worked at the brand now cannot be posted until that person has a login linked to their HR record (then delete the draft and compute again), or until the approver leaves them out by name with a reason, which is audited. This applies to existing drafts too. Tip pooling is off by default (tipPoolEnabled), so only companies that turned it on are affected. Brief the CEO/finance before Monday.
2) No schema or migration change, and no deploy-order constraint.
3) Owner decision still open: FOH, BOH and F&B managers no longer reach tip pools, capital or projections. If floor managers should draft nightly pools, grant 'payroll' in Module Access.
